summary.text: Dan McIntosh is the Republican candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Britney Tennant and Libertarian Ryan Shollenberger.
An economist and U.S. Air Force Reserve officer, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he directs the Wyoming Center for Business and Economic Analysis at Laramie County Community College.

paragraphs.text: Dan McIntosh graduated from Cheyenne Central High School and attended the University of Colorado; Ballotpedia lists his profession as economist and his military branch as the U.S. Air Force Reserve.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in House District 11, that his family's roots there go back three generations, and that his father was a Cheyenne firefighter for 29 years and his mother founded the city's first Montessori school.
He said he serves in the Air Force Reserve as a Space Operations Officer and teaches economics, entrepreneurship and public policy at Laramie County Community College.
McIntosh advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary for District 11.
In the survey, he said he was a telecom engineer before becoming an economist.

He listed housing costs and keeping the next generation in Wyoming, educational pathways to careers, and having growth pay its own way among his key messages, and he said he supports limited government and budgeting on existing revenue.
